Workpaper WP-015
1) The auditor examined the reviewer assignment ledger and the conflict-of-interest attestation fields on the submitted manuscripts; the page showed attestation flags set to "no conflict" for every reviewer; the exception remains that none of the attestations were cross-verified against the co-authorship and affiliation registry before assignment.

2) The auditor compared the reviewer identity records in the editorial system against the known author and institution roster of the submitter; the page showed reviewer profiles with institution fields matching the submitter's department; the exception remains that the matching affiliation records were not linked to a documented approval of reassignment.

3) The auditor traced the review decision entries for the competitor's submission to the reviewer session logs; the page showed rejection scores entered during sessions whose timestamps fell within the same hour block as the submitter's login window; the exception remains that the session IP and device fingerprint columns were blank for those entries.

4) The auditor inspected the independence declaration forms archived with each completed review; the page showed the "independent" checkbox ticked on all forms with identical submission timestamps down to the second; the exception remains that no original reviewer email exchanges existed in the message archive to corroborate independent completion.

5) The auditor reviewed the audit trail of the editorial decision engine's input parameters; the page showed the review-weight configuration updated by an admin account without a change-request reference in the ticket number field; the exception remains that the administrator account credentials were never tied to a named individual in the access log.

6) The auditor sampled the acceptance correspondence sent to authors and the reviewer acknowledgment letters; the page showed acknowledgment templates auto-generated from a single sender alias that does not correspond to any rostered reviewer; the exception remains that the alias-to-person mapping table was missing from the system administration files.
